project: Momma ERP - MIA Stock Module Full Integration
description: Complete granular MIA integration for the entire Stock/Inventory module: VisualizacaoEstoque, Movimentacoes, VerificacaoPerdas (with LossAnalyticsDashboard), BatchTraceability, Producao (Insumos, FichasTecnicas, OrdensProducao, PerdasQualidade), and all sub-components.

userStories.title: Rewrite useMiaEstoqueActions with full granular coverage
userStories.description: As a user on /visualizacao-estoque, I want MIA to control every aspect: sector filter, status filter, search, expand items, toggle visibility, and understand batch data.
acceptanceCriteria: Rewrite src/hooks/estoque/useMiaEstoqueActions.ts with expanded interface: setSelectedSector, setSelectedStatus, setSearchTerm, setShowHidden, toggleExpand(id), toggleVisibility(item), items data array

Handlers: estoque_filter (sector+status+search), estoque_expand (product_id), estoque_toggle_hidden (show/hide hidden products), estoque_toggle_visibility (toggle specific product visibility), clear_filters
Wire into VisualizacaoEstoque.tsx — pass all actual setters including setShowHidden and toggleVisibility
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read VisualizacaoEstoque.tsx first to get exact state names. toggleVisibility takes an item object with id and oculto flag.

userStories.title: Rewrite useMiaPerdasActions with full granular coverage including photo, lote, analytics
userStories.description: As a user on /verificacao-perdas, I want MIA to fully manage losses: switch tabs, fill forms with all fields (store, product, qty, unit, reason, lote, validade, obs), submit, verify, delete, filter history, and trigger analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Rewrite src/hooks/perdas/useMiaPerdasActions.ts with FULL interface covering ALL state: activeTab, filterStore, filterProduct, filterDateStart, filterDateEnd, selectedStore, selectedProductId, selectedProductQuery, quantity, unit, reason, obs, lote, validade, handleSubmit, verifyLoss(id), deleteLoss(id), fetchLosses, losses array

Handlers: perdas_select_tab, perdas_filter (store+product+dateStart+dateEnd), perdas_create (fill ALL form fields including lote and validade), perdas_submit (trigger handleSubmit), perdas_verify (mark loss as verified), perdas_delete (delete a loss record), perdas_export (export Excel), perdas_analytics_filter (set analytics date range/store/reason), clear_filters
Wire into VerificacaoPerdas.tsx — pass ALL setters including selectedProductQuery, lote, validade, verifyLoss, deleteLoss, fetchLosses
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read VerificacaoPerdas.tsx carefully. The form has: selectedStore, selectedProductQuery (autocomplete search), selectedProductId, quantity, unit, reason, obs, lote, validade. verifyLoss and deleteLoss are functions that take an ID.
